Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The agent misinterpreted the search results and hallucinated a specific religious affiliation. While the search snippet mentioned Avicenna's association with the "Ismaili Doctrinarian" school, this refers to his philosophical and theological influence on Ismaili thought, not his personal membership or denomination. The agent incorrectly equated this philosophical association with actual religious sect membership, leading to the false conclusion that he was a member of the Ismaili (Shia) denomination, whereas historical consensus identifies him as Sunni.
